request: MAG-27 — manual-rerun HTTP API for ProcessVehicleData. Expose an HTTP endpoint that triggers one internal/app.Processor.ProcessVehicleData cycle on demand, so a full sync -> charging -> analytics run can be forced without waiting for the nightly scheduler or shelling into the box to run go run ./cmd/poller --once. This was RM29 tier 8, parked by roadmap decision D9. Owner's added context, verbatim: "I'd like to have an API (Without athentication with a resource name hard to guess) to simulate running the nightly job (Or similar how it's behaving the cmd-poller-once) just that this time is via API (Because the VPS does not allow me to run the poller)"

review.brief: Review the four wave commits 0ad6118..dc1ed06 as one diff. Check: (1) every design.md decision D1-D9 is honoured in the code, especially D4(b) — the handler must close over the poller ROOT ctx, never r.Context(); (2) D3 — no code path calls ProcessVehicleData un-guarded, and one mutex covers both triggers; (3) every spec scenario in specs/manual-rerun-api/spec.md is satisfied by real code; (4) module boundaries — internal/app and internal/telemetry received doc-comment edits ONLY, no logic; internal/config gained no net/http knowledge; (5) doc-pack conventions, including CLAUDE.md's docs-track-structural-change rule and the archive-immutability rule; (6) the declared Performance-Profile; (7) anti-gaming — no acceptance criterion was weakened, no status self-approved. Signals: go build, go vet, gofmt and migration/boundary/archive/tz/money guards were ASSISTANT-run and clean. `make test` was USER-run and the user reported it passed — do not run the suite yourself. Unit tests are excluded by owner decision D9-6, so their absence is not a finding.

decisions.decision: owning module = config; change name takes the platform- prefix
decisions.why: Only internal/config gets code. internal/app is doc-only. The substance is in cmd/poller and deploy/docker, so it is cross-cutting.

decisions.decision: used CH48, not the counter's CH47
decisions.why: Branch ft/CH47-MAG-53 already exists, so 47 was taken. Numbers are monotonic and never reused. Counter set to 49.

decisions.decision: the built-in database design gate does not fire
decisions.why: The change adds no table, column, index, constraint, view or migration. design.md D7 records why no triggered_by index is added.
The poller already builds the Processor. One instance is shared by both triggers, so they cannot drift. Rejected cmd/web and a new binary.

decisions.decision: no auth; secret path segment POLLER_RERUN_TOKEN from .env, fail closed
decisions.why: Owner asked for a hard-to-guess resource name. Empty var means no route at all. Owner knowingly accepted the secret appearing in Caddy logs.

decisions.decision: overlap rejected with 409, via one shared mutex covering both triggers
decisions.why: Two paid Fleet API cycles must never run at once. Rejected queueing and rejected allowing concurrency.

decisions.decision: 202 Accepted, cycle runs in background on the poller root context
decisions.why: Owner will not wait 1-3 minutes for the car to wake. Body carries no run_id, because the port signature is out of scope.

decisions.decision: a nightly run is skipped if a manual cycle is running; documented, not prevented
decisions.why: Leader found this gap after the worker returned. Owner chose one lock behaviour over never losing a night. Spec scenario and D3 note added.
cmd/poller has never had a test file, by design. Testing would force the handler into a new internal/ package, contradicting D1.

decisions.decision: a token that makes an invalid ServeMux pattern turns the listener off, it never panics the poller
decisions.why: Leader found http.ServeMux panics on a bad pattern. With restart: unless-stopped that crash-loops the poller and kills the nightly cycle. Owner picked the guard over a loud crash.
Owner ran make test and reported it passed. The assistant never ran it. T1, T2 and T7 move from awaiting-user-verification to done.
